To maximize your festival experience without getting trapped in peak-hour vehicular bottlenecks, timing is everything. Visiting between 3:00 PM and 5:30 PM allows you to appreciate idol craftsmanship and intricate pandal architecture in soft daylight before crowds surge.

Looking for complete details on the famous  Central Colony Durga Puja 2026  in  Central Colony, Siliguri ? For its milestone 64th edition, the renowned  Central Colony Durga Puja Committee  has officially relocated its flagship celebrations to the expansive  Barrack Colony Ground , located right adjacent to New Jalpaiguri (NJP) Police Station.

Whether you are arriving by train at NJP Station or travelling from Central Siliguri, this verified guide covers the new venue, 64th-year theme, transit routes, and parking guidelines for  Siliguri Central Colony Durga Puja 2026 .

One of the most frequent questions from devotees this season is whether  Central Colony Durga Puja  is still at its historic Railway Institute grounds. Due to exponential crowd surges exceeding 50,000 visitors per night, the  Central Colony Durga Puja Committee  took the strategic civic decision to relocate the main pandal and carnival fair to the massive  Barrack Colony Ground .

The new venue offers over triple the open area compared to previous years. This expansion ensures wide pedestrian circulation lanes, dedicated emergency access, and an extensive family mela without claustrophobic bottlenecking.

Meanwhile, the heritage  Central Colony Railway Institute Ground  continues to host authentic morning rituals, traditional pushpanjali, and railway community cultural exhibitions. Hoppers can easily experience both venues within a short 3-minute stroll in  Central Colony Siliguri .

For the  Central Colony Siliguri Durga Puja 2026 , master artisans have erected a monumental temple-style architectural replica titled  "Grand Architectural Splendor" . Crafted with sustainable bamboo, wood carvings, and terracotta embellishments, the pandal facade towers over 70 feet high.

Special lighting displays conceived by veteran Chandannagar light technicians illuminate the entrance corridor with animated mythological motifs. Inside the sanctum sanctorum, the idol of Goddess Durga reflects a harmonious blend of traditional  Sabeki  grace and regal poise.

This visual spectacle consistently ranks Central Colony among the top crowd favorites in the southern quadrant of Siliguri alongside Babupara and Hakimpara champions.

Finding your way to the  Siliguri Central Colony Durga Puja  is straightforward due to its prime proximity to New Jalpaiguri (NJP) Railway Junction and the Burdwan Road artery.
